name: 3rd party - booking embed
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - booking embed.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Merchant-owned provider code runs as supplied. The provider must supply accessible iframe titles, its form/calendar configuration, and any editor reload support. Add an actual configured embed; this wrapper does not submit data or confirm bookings.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Description
settings.default: Use the scheduler below to pick a time that works best for you.
settings.how: Write the description. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Embed code (calendar / booking widget)
settings.info: Paste the full provider HTML/iframe/script snippet. Minimum iframe heights below frame the widget; its script owns resizing and behavior. Test multiple instances and Theme Editor reload with your provider.
settings.how: Write the embed code (calendar / booking widget). Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Show "having trouble?" link
settings.how: Turn on “Show "having trouble?" link” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Help link text
settings.default: Having trouble booking? Contact us directly.
settings.how: Enter the help link text. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Help link URL
settings.how: Enter the help link url. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Content alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Background style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Content width
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for content width. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Section aria label
settings.how: Enter the section aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Minimum iframe height (desktop)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust minimum iframe height (desktop). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Minimum iframe height (mobile)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust minimum iframe height (mobile). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.heading: Schedule your consultation
settings.description: Choose an available appointment using the configured booking calendar.
